title: Betsy Wolfe and Ethan Slater are an absolute DREAM together hilarious...
transcript: I've always thought that Betsy Wolfe and Ethan Slater would be the perfect Audrey and Seymour. Happy to report that I was 100% correct. This was my 10th time seeing this production of Little Shop of horrors. I've seen many different casts over its run, and my favourite thing about this production is how each cast makes the show feel so different. It gives it new energy, it makes it feel fresh. And to me, Betsy and Ethan are the funniest cast they've ever had. I truly think Betsy Wolf has one of the best comedic senses on Broadway, and her very specific brand of humor fits so well. Her and Ethan lean hard into the campy, heightened, slightly unhinged energy of an 80s B horror film. Betsy always understands exactly how far to push a comedic moment without ever turning Audrey into a joke, while Ethan is so earnest and awkward and endearing. He also just understands like, physical humor and movement better than anyone. And shout out to Claybourne Elder who is the current Orin and played him so fearlessly and quirky and over the top. I cried laughing. But truly, the entire cast right now is just so ridiculously strong. There's a reason that this production of Little Shop of horrors can still run after all these years. It has figured out the magic to let performers do their own thing, find their own characters, without losing any of the magic that makes it so special in The first place. So even if you've already visited Skid Row before, I highly recommend making your way back. This cast absolutely cannot be missed. I hope Little Shop stays open forever and always, and I will never stop returning to it.
reasoning: Creator's 10th visit, calls this the funniest cast ever, praises every lead, and explicitly urges viewers to return. Unambiguous rave.
keyQuote: This cast absolutely cannot be missed.
